paite: Huan long ah lut in agalkah a, ama khua ahong tung hi.
heading: Jesu'n Zeng Damlou Ahihdam / (Mar 2.1-12; Luk 5.17-26)
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

paite: Ngai in, mizeng khat damlou, lupna a lum ahon zawng ua; huchi in Jesu'n aginna uh mu in, zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Tapa, khamuangtak in om in, na khelhnate ngaihdam ahita," achi hi.
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

paite: Ngai in, laigelhmi kuate hiam akingaihtuah ua, "Hiai mi'n Pathian agensia," achi uh.
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n angaihtuahte uh athei a, "Bangziak a na lungtang ua gilou ngaihtuah na hi ua? achi hi.
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

paite: 'Na khelhnate ngaihdam hi hen' chih leh 'thou inla, khe in pai in, chih koi abaihlamzaw?'
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

paite: Himahleh Mihing Tapa in leitung ah khelhnate ngaihdam theihna anei chih na theihna ding un," zeng damloupa kiang ah, "Thou in, na lupna la inla, na inn ah pai in,” achi hi.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

paite: Huchi in athou a, a-inn ah apaita hi.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

paite: Himahleh, mipi'n amuh un lamdang asa ua, huchibang hihtheihna mihingte kiang a pepa, Pathian apahtawita uhi.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, siah piakna mun a tu, mi khat, amin Matthai amu a; akiang ah, "Hon zui in," achi a, huchi in athou a, azuita hi.
heading: Matthai Sapna / (Mar 2.13-17; Luk 5.27-32)
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-inn a ankuang a-um lai in, ngai in, siahkhonte leh mikhial tampi ahong pai ua, Jesu leh anungzuite a-umpih uhi.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

paite: Pharisaite'n huai amuh un, anungzuite kiang ah, "Bangziak a na heutupa un siahkhonte leh mikhialte kiang a ne ahia?" achi uhi.
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n huai azaktak in, "Midamtheite'n daktor akiphamoh kei ua, midamtheiloute'n akiphamohzaw uhi.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

paite: Huchi in 'kithoihna deih lou in zahngaihna ka deih hi,' chih, a-omdan va zil un, midiktatte sam dia hong pai ka hi kei a, mikhialte sam ding a hong pai ka hi zaw," achi hi.
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

paite: Huchih lai in akiang ah Johan nungzuite ahong pai ua, "Bangziak a kou leh Pharisaite'n an ngawl zelzel ua, na nungzuite'n ngawl lou uh ahia?" achi uhi.
heading: An Ngawl Thu A Dotna / (Mar 2.18-22; Luk 5.27-32)
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Moupite kiang a apasal a-om lai teng moupite'n asuun thei ua hia? Himahleh, akiang ua kipan apasal pimang nite ahong tung ding a, huai hun chiang in an angawl ding uhi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

paite: Huan kuamah in puan lui puan tui khai louh them in athuap ngei kei; athuapna in puan akaihkek ding ziak in, ahong nakkek zaw sem ding hi.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

paite: Kuamah in uain thak savun uain thawl lui ah athun ngei kei uh; huchi lou in zaw savun thawlte apuakkek dia, uain abo dia, savun thawl leng hong kise ding; huaiziak in savun uain thawl thak ah uain thak athun zaw ua, huchi in hoihtak in a-om tuaktuak hi,” achi hi.
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

paite: Huan akiang ua agen laitak in, ngai in, vaihawmpa khat ahong pai a, amah bia in, "Tu mah in ka tanu asi a; himahleh hong pai inla, atung ah na khut koih lechin ahong hing nawn ding," achi hi.
heading: Jaira Tanu Leh Numei Sipawt Damna / (Mar 5.21-43; Luk 8.40-56)
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

paite: Huchi in Jesu athou a, azuita a, nungzuite'n leng azui uhi.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

paite: Ngai in, numei khat kum sawm leh kum nih sipawt damlou, anung ah hong pai a, apuan mong akhoihsak hi.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

paite: "Apuan mongkai khoih lel leng, hihdam in ka om mai ding," alungsim in achi hi.
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

paite: Huan Jesu akihei a, amah amu a, "Ka tanu, khamuangtak in om in; na ginna na dampih hi," achi hi. Huchi in numeinu huai dakkal a kipan adamta hi.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

paite: Vaihawmpa inn ah Jesu alut a, tamngai tumte leh mipi thawm ngaih vengvungte ava muh in,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

paite: "Pawt un; naupang asi kei, ihmu ahi zaw," achi hi. Amau bel amah anuihsan maimah uh.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

paite: Himahleh mipite polam a apawtsak zoh in amah alut a, naupang khut ah alen a, hong thou maimah hi.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

paite: Hiai tanchin huai gam tengteng ah athangkheta hi.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

paite: Huai a kipan Jesu apai zel a, mittaw nih in, "David Tapa, ka tung uah zahngai in," chi a kikou in azui uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Mittaw Mi Nih Ahihdam
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

paite: Huan inn a alutleh akiang ah mittawte ahong pai ua; Jesu'n akiang uah, "Hiai hihthei ding in na hon gingta ua hia?" achi hi. Amaute'n akiang ah, "Gingta e, Toupa," achi uhi.
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

paite: Ama'n amit uh akhoihsak a, "Na gintak bang un na tung uah tung hen," achi hi.
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

paite: Huchi in amitte uh hong vakta hi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Kuamah theih louh ding in pilvang un," achi bilbel hi.
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

paite: Himahleh amau apawt ua, huai gam tengteng ah atanchin agenthangta uhi.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

paite: Huai a pan apawt laitak un, ngai in, dawimat pau thei lou khat akiang ah ahon pi uhi.
heading: Dawimat Pau Thei Lou Khat Jesu Hihdamna
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

paite: Huai dawi adelhkhiaktak in pau thei lou tuh ahong pauta a; mipite'n lamdang asa mahmah ua, "Israelte lak ah hichibang akimu ngei kei hi,” achi uhi.
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

paite: Pharisaite'n bel, "Dawi kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak nak," achi uh.
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n asinagogte ua hilh a, lalgam tanchinhoih gen in, damlouhna chiteng leh natna chiteng ahihdam a, kholian leh khoneu tengteng atawn vialvial hi.
heading: Jesu'n Mipite Ahehpih
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

paite: Huchi in mipite amuh in, chingtu nei lou belamte bang a gimthuak leh dalh a a-om ziak un alainat mahmah hi.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

paite: Anungzuite kiang ah, "Buh lak ding atam mahmah a, himahleh sem mite atawm uhi.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

paite: Huaiziak in abuh la dia sem dingte sawl ding in buh neipa kiang ah ngen un," achi hi.
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”
